en: Black‑and‑white image of a large European town square dominated by an ornate town hall with a tall clock tower and steep tiled roofs in a late‑historicist / neo‑Renaissance style. In front of the building stands a richly decorated fountain or monument. Surrounding the square are rows of narrow multi‑storey houses with dormer windows and shops at street level. A few pedestrians are visible in the open cobbled square.
